# google_discovery_engine_document_import

Imports documents from Cloud Storage or BigQuery into a Discovery Engine
data store branch.

~> **Note:** This resource represents an imperative `ImportDocuments`
operation rather than an individually addressable API resource. Once created,
Terraform does not poll or detect out-of-band modifications to the imported
documents in Discovery Engine. Changing any import configuration field
replaces the resource and triggers a new import operation.


To get more information about DocumentImport, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.collections.dataStores.branches.documents/import)
* How-to Guides
    * [Prepare data for ingesting](https://cloud.google.com/generative-ai-app-builder/docs/prepare-data)

## Example Usage - Discoveryengine Document Import Basic


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_discovery_engine_data_store" "basic" {
  location                     = "global"
  data_store_id                = "data-store-id"
  display_name                 = "tf-test-datastore-doc-import"
  industry_vertical            = "GENERIC"
  content_config               = "NO_CONTENT"
  solution_types               = ["SOLUTION_TYPE_SEARCH"]
  create_advanced_site_search  = false
  skip_default_schema_creation = false
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "import_bucket" {
  name                        = "import-bucket"
  location                    = "US"
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "discoveryengine_access" {
  bucket     = google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name
  role       = "roles/storage.objectViewer"
  member     = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-discoveryengine.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  depends_on = [google_discovery_engine_data_store.basic]
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "documents" {
  name    = "documents.jsonl"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name
  content = <<-EOT
    {"title":"Terraform Document 1","category":"guide"}
    {"title":"Terraform Document 2","category":"reference"}
  EOT
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_document_import" "basic" {
  location              = google_discovery_engine_data_store.basic.location
  data_store_id         = google_discovery_engine_data_store.basic.data_store_id
  branch_id             = "default_branch"
  import_id             = "initial-import"
  reconciliation_mode   = "INCREMENTAL"
  auto_generate_ids     = true
  force_refresh_content = false
  deletion_policy       = "FORCE"

  gcs_source {
    input_uris  = ["gs://${google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.documents.name}"]
    data_schema = "custom"
  }

  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.discoveryengine_access]
}
```

## Example Usage - Discoveryengine Document Import Full


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_discovery_engine_data_store" "full" {
  location                     = "global"
  data_store_id                = "data-store-id"
  display_name                 = "tf-test-datastore-doc-import-full"
  industry_vertical            = "GENERIC"
  content_config               = "NO_CONTENT"
  solution_types               = ["SOLUTION_TYPE_SEARCH"]
  create_advanced_site_search  = false
  skip_default_schema_creation = false
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "import_bucket" {
  name                        = "import-bucket-full"
  location                    = "US"
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "discoveryengine_access" {
  bucket     = google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name
  role       = "roles/storage.admin"
  member     = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-discoveryengine.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  depends_on = [google_discovery_engine_data_store.full]
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "documents" {
  name    = "documents.jsonl"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name
  content = <<-EOT
    {"doc_id":"doc-1","title":"Full Import Document 1"}
    {"doc_id":"doc-2","title":"Full Import Document 2"}
  EOT
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_document_import" "full" {
  location              = google_discovery_engine_data_store.full.location
  collection_id         = "default_collection"
  data_store_id         = google_discovery_engine_data_store.full.data_store_id
  branch_id             = "default_branch"
  import_id             = "full-import"
  reconciliation_mode   = "FULL"
  auto_generate_ids     = false
  id_field              = "doc_id"
  force_refresh_content = true
  deletion_policy       = "DELETE"

  gcs_source {
    input_uris  = ["gs://${google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.documents.name}"]
    data_schema = "custom"
  }

  error_config {
    gcs_prefix = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.import_bucket.name}/errors"
  }

  depends_on = [google_storage_bucket_iam_member.discoveryengine_access]
}
```

## Example Usage - Discoveryengine Document Import Bigquery


```hcl
data "google_project" "project" {}

resource "google_discovery_engine_data_store" "bigquery" {
  location                     = "global"
  data_store_id                = "data-store-id"
  display_name                 = "tf-test-datastore-doc-import-bq"
  industry_vertical            = "GENERIC"
  content_config               = "NO_CONTENT"
  solution_types               = ["SOLUTION_TYPE_SEARCH"]
  create_advanced_site_search  = false
  skip_default_schema_creation = false
}

resource "google_storage_bucket" "staging_bucket" {
  name                        = "import-bq-staging"
  location                    = "US"
  force_destroy               = true
  uniform_bucket_level_access = true
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "discoveryengine_storage_access" {
  bucket     = google_storage_bucket.staging_bucket.name
  role       = "roles/storage.admin"
  member     = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-discoveryengine.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  depends_on = [google_discovery_engine_data_store.bigquery]
}

resource "google_storage_bucket_object" "bq_seed" {
  name    = "seed/bq_documents.jsonl"
  bucket  = google_storage_bucket.staging_bucket.name
  content = <<-EOT
    {"doc_id":"bq-doc-1","title":"BigQuery Document 1"}
    {"doc_id":"bq-doc-2","title":"BigQuery Document 2"}
  EOT
}

resource "google_bigquery_dataset" "import_dataset" {
  dataset_id                 = "import_dataset"
  location                   = "US"
  delete_contents_on_destroy = true
}

resource "google_bigquery_dataset_iam_member" "discoveryengine_bq_access" {
  dataset_id = google_bigquery_dataset.import_dataset.dataset_id
  role       = "roles/bigquery.dataViewer"
  member     = "serviceAccount:service-${data.google_project.project.number}@gcp-sa-discoveryengine.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  depends_on = [google_discovery_engine_data_store.bigquery]
}

resource "google_bigquery_table" "import_table" {
  dataset_id          = google_bigquery_dataset.import_dataset.dataset_id
  table_id            = "import_table"
  deletion_protection = false

  time_partitioning {
    type = "DAY"
  }

  schema = jsonencode([
    {
      name = "doc_id"
      type = "STRING"
      mode = "REQUIRED"
    },
    {
      name = "title"
      type = "STRING"
      mode = "NULLABLE"
    }
  ])
}

resource "google_bigquery_job" "load_partition" {
  job_id   = "insert-bq-docs"
  location = "US"

  load {
    source_uris = [
      "gs://${google_storage_bucket.staging_bucket.name}/${google_storage_bucket_object.bq_seed.name}"
    ]
    source_format     = "NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON"
    write_disposition = "WRITE_TRUNCATE"

    destination_table {
      project_id = google_bigquery_table.import_table.project
      dataset_id = google_bigquery_table.import_table.dataset_id
      table_id   = "${google_bigquery_table.import_table.table_id}$20261026"
    }
  }
}

resource "google_discovery_engine_document_import" "bigquery" {
  location            = google_discovery_engine_data_store.bigquery.location
  collection_id       = "default_collection"
  data_store_id       = google_discovery_engine_data_store.bigquery.data_store_id
  branch_id           = "default_branch"
  import_id           = "bq-import"
  reconciliation_mode = "INCREMENTAL"
  auto_generate_ids   = false
  id_field            = "doc_id"

  bigquery_source {
    project_id      = data.google_project.project.project_id
    dataset_id      = google_bigquery_dataset.import_dataset.dataset_id
    table_id        = google_bigquery_table.import_table.table_id
    gcs_staging_dir = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.staging_bucket.name}/staging"
    data_schema     = "custom"

    partition_date {
      year  = 2026
      month = 10
      day   = 26
    }
  }

  error_config {
    gcs_prefix = "gs://${google_storage_bucket.staging_bucket.name}/errors"
  }

  depends_on = [
    google_storage_bucket_iam_member.discoveryengine_storage_access,
    google_bigquery_dataset_iam_member.discoveryengine_bq_access,
    google_bigquery_job.load_partition,
  ]
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The geographic location where the data store resides. The value can
  only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".

* `data_store_id` -
  (Required)
  The unique ID of the target data store.

* `import_id` -
  (Required)
  A client-assigned identifier used to distinguish multiple document import
  resources targeting the same data store branch in Terraform state.
  Must be 1-63 characters of alphanumeric characters, hyphens, or underscores,
  starting with an alphanumeric character.


* `gcs_source` -
  (Optional)
  Cloud Storage location for the input content.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_gcs_source).

* `bigquery_source` -
  (Optional)
  BigQuery input source configuration.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_bigquery_source).

* `reconciliation_mode` -
  (Optional)
  The mode of reconciliation between existing documents and the documents to
  be imported. Defaults to `INCREMENTAL`.
  Default value is `INCREMENTAL`.
  Possible values are: `INCREMENTAL`, `FULL`.

* `auto_generate_ids` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to automatically generate IDs for the documents if absent.
  If set to `true`, `Document.id`s are automatically generated based on the
  hash of the payload, where IDs may not be consistent during multiple imports.
  Only supported when `data_schema` on `gcs_source` or `bigquery_source` is
  `custom` or `csv`; otherwise, the API returns an `INVALID_ARGUMENT` error.

* `id_field` -
  (Optional)
  The field or column name to be used as unique IDs of the documents.
  For `gcs_source`, it is the key of the JSON field (for example, `my_id` for
  JSON `{"my_id": "some_uuid"}`). For `bigquery_source`, it is the column name
  of the table where the unique IDs are stored.
  Only set this field when `auto_generate_ids` is unset or set to `false`, and
  when `data_schema` is `custom` or `csv`. If unset, `_id` is used by default
  for `custom` or `csv` schemas.

* `force_refresh_content` -
  (Optional)
  Whether to force refresh the unstructured content of the documents.
  If set to `true`, the content part of the documents will be refreshed
  regardless of the update status of the referencing content.

* `error_config` -
  (Optional)
  The desired location of errors incurred during the Import.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_error_config).

* `collection_id` -
  (Optional)
  The collection ID. Defaults to `default_collection`.

* `branch_id` -
  (Optional)
  The target branch ID within the data store. Defaults to `default_branch`.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) The deletion policy for the document import. Defaults to `DELETE`.

* `DELETE` or `ABANDON`: Removes the resource from Terraform state without
  deleting imported documents from the Discovery Engine branch.
* `PREVENT`: Blocks `terraform destroy` or configuration changes that would
  delete or replace the resource.
* `FORCE`: Invokes `DocumentService.PurgeDocuments` with `filter = "*"` and
  `force = true` on the target branch before removing the resource from
  Terraform state.

~> **Warning:** Discovery Engine's `PurgeDocuments` API only supports branch-wide
purging (`filter = "*"`). When `deletion_policy = "FORCE"`, destroying or replacing
this resource (for example, due to changing an immutable import attribute) will
permanently delete **all documents in the target branch**, including documents
created outside this Terraform resource.



<a name="nested_gcs_source"></a>The `gcs_source` block supports:

* `input_uris` -
  (Required)
  Cloud Storage URIs to input files. Each URI can be up to 2000 characters
  long. URIs can match the full object path (for example,
  `gs://bucket/directory/object.json`) or a pattern matching one or more
  files, such as `gs://bucket/directory/*.json`.

* `data_schema` -
  (Optional)
  The schema to use when parsing the data from the source.
  Supported values for document imports:
  * `document` (default): One JSON `Document` per line. Each document must
    have a valid `Document.id`.
  * `content`: Unstructured data (for example, PDF, HTML). Each file matched
    by `input_uris` becomes a document.
  * `custom`: One custom data JSON per row in arbitrary format that conforms
    to the defined `Schema` of the data store. Can only be used by the
    `GENERIC` Data Store vertical.
  * `csv`: A CSV file with header conforming to the defined `Schema` of the
    data store. Each entry after the header is imported as a Document. Can
    only be used by the `GENERIC` Data Store vertical.

<a name="nested_bigquery_source"></a>The `bigquery_source` block supports:

* `project_id` -
  (Optional)
  The project ID or the project number that contains the BigQuery source.
  If not specified, inherits the project ID from the parent request.

* `dataset_id` -
  (Required)
  The BigQuery dataset ID to copy the data from.

* `table_id` -
  (Required)
  The BigQuery table ID to copy the data from.

* `gcs_staging_dir` -
  (Optional)
  Intermediate Cloud Storage directory used for the import with a length
  limit of 2,000 characters. Can be specified if one wants to have the
  BigQuery export to a specific Cloud Storage directory.

* `data_schema` -
  (Optional)
  The schema to use when parsing the data from the source.
  Supported values for document imports:
  * `document` (default): One `Document` format per row. Each document must
    have a valid `Document.id` and one of `Document.json_data` or
    `Document.struct_data`.
  * `custom`: One custom data per row in arbitrary format that conforms to
    the defined `Schema` of the data store. Can only be used by the
    `GENERIC` Data Store vertical.

* `partition_date` -
  (Optional)
  BigQuery ingestion-time partitioned table's `_PARTITIONDATE` in
  `YYYY-MM-DD` format. Leave empty if the BigQuery table is not
  ingestion-time partitioned.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_bigquery_source_partition_date).


<a name="nested_bigquery_source_partition_date"></a>The `partition_date` block supports:

* `year` -
  (Required)
  Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999.

* `month` -
  (Required)
  Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12.

* `day` -
  (Required)
  Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month.

<a name="nested_error_config"></a>The `error_config` block supports:

* `gcs_prefix` -
  (Required)
  Cloud Storage prefix for import errors. This must be an empty,
  existing Cloud Storage directory. Import errors are written to
  sharded files in this directory, one per line, as a JSON-encoded
  `google.rpc.Status` message.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/collections/{{collection_id}}/dataStores/{{data_store_id}}/branches/{{branch_id}}/imports/{{import_id}}`


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 60 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 60 minutes.

## Import

This resource does not support import.

## User Project Overrides

This resource supports [User Project Overrides](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/google/latest/docs/guides/provider_reference#user_project_override).
